description: Application-owned paginated acquisition engine for California CDSS childcare DataStore resources with person/contact fields excluded at query time.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed official DataStore endpoints and resource IDs only.
retry: No automatic retry or fallback. Publisher deferral, count drift, schema drift, privacy-field exposure, or membership drift stops the attempt.
checkpoint: A durable prerequisite is required before page requests and every selected page must be durably retained before the next request. Official totals are rechecked after all pages.
idempotency: One immutable operation owns its retained prerequisite and ordered page journal. Partial journals are inspectable but are not an automatic resume promise.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain the active durable-retention hook, and never claim a complete acquisition after cancellation.
retention_profile: Internal selected fields only. Licensee, administrator, telephone, email, person, and contact fields are excluded at query time and rejected if returned.
